create table if not exists public.sa_haven_region_overrides (
  haven_id uuid primary key references public.havens(id) on delete cascade,
  region_code text not null references public.sa_regions(code),
  note text,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create or replace function public.gbqs_haven_region(p_haven_id uuid)
returns text language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce(
    (select o.region_code from sa_haven_region_overrides o where o.haven_id = h.id),
    case
      when h.land_code = 'FR' and h.latitude < 44.6 and h.longitude > 2.5 then 'med'
      when h.land_code = 'ES' and h.longitude < -12 then 'afr'
      when h.land_code = 'ES' and h.longitude > -5.7 and h.latitude < 42.6 then 'med'
      when h.land_code = 'MA' and h.longitude <= -6 then 'afr'
      when h.land_code = 'RU' and h.longitude > 60 then 'fea'
      when h.land_code = 'RU' and h.latitude >= 47.5 then 'nwe'
      when h.land_code = 'EG' and h.latitude < 30.5 and h.longitude > 32.4 then 'mea'
      else null
    end,
    (select rc.region_code from sa_region_countries rc where rc.land_code = h.land_code))
  from havens h where h.id = p_haven_id
$$;

-- 2. Surveybedrijven en gebruikers ------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.surveyor_companies (
  id               uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name             text not null,
  domain           text,
  country          text,
  address          text,
  zip_code         text,
  city             text,
  vat_number       text,
  office_email     text,
  invoice_email    text,
  phone            text,
  website          text,
  logo_path        text,
  logo_updated_at  timestamptz,
  region_code      text references public.sa_regions(code),
  status           text not null default 'pending',
  verified_at      timestamptz,
  verified_by      text,
  early_bird       boolean not null default false,
  interest_id      uuid references public.surveyor_interest(id) on delete set null,
  terms_version    text,
  terms_accepted_at timestamptz,
  stripe_customer_id text,
  notes            text,
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint surveyor_companies_status_check check (status in ('pending','approved','suspended','blocked')),
  constraint surveyor_companies_domain_lower check (domain is null or domain = lower(domain))
);
create index if not exists surveyor_companies_domain_idx on public.surveyor_companies(domain);
comment on table public.surveyor_companies is
  'Surveyor access: survey companies using the platform themselves. status pending until ops verified the company (needed before first paid bundle and before the rating is shown to clients).';

alter table public.surveyors add column if not exists company_id uuid references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete set null;
create index if not exists surveyors_company_idx on public.surveyors(company_id);

create table if not exists public.surveyor_company_users (
  user_id      uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  company_id   uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  email        text not null,
  full_name    text,
  is_office    boolean not null default true,
  is_surveyor  boolean not null default true,
  is_admin     boolean not null default false,
  surveyor_id  uuid references public.surveyors(id) on delete set null,
  status       text not null default 'active',
  invited_by   uuid,
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint surveyor_company_users_status_check check (status in ('invited','active','disabled')),
  constraint surveyor_company_users_role_check check (is_office or is_surveyor)
);
create index if not exists surveyor_company_users_company_idx on public.surveyor_company_users(company_id);

create table if not exists public.surveyor_company_ports (
  company_id uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  haven_id   uuid not null references public.havens(id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (company_id, haven_id)
);

-- 3. Eigen klanten ------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.surveyor_clients (
  id               uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id       uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  name             text not null,
  contact_name     text,
  report_emails    text[] not null default '{}',
  address          text,
  country          text,
  vat_number       text,
  domain           text,
  linked_client_id uuid references public.clients(id) on delete set null,
  notes            text,
  archived_at      timestamptz,
  created_at       timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at       timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists surveyor_clients_company_idx on public.surveyor_clients(company_id);
comment on column public.surveyor_clients.linked_client_id is
  'Set when this own client is also a GlobalBQS client (A13 case 3): the survey then appears for that client as an external report only.';

-- 4. Eigen jobs ---------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.sa_counters (
  name  text not null,
  year  integer not null,
  last  integer not null default 0,
  primary key (name, year)
);

create table if not exists public.surveyor_jobs (
  id                  uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id          uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  reference           text not null unique,
  surveyor_client_id  uuid references public.surveyor_clients(id) on delete set null,
  vessel_id           uuid references public.vessels(id),
  vessel_name         text,
  imo_number          text,
  haven_id            uuid references public.havens(id),
  port_text           text,
  berth_or_terminal   text,
  eta                 timestamptz,
  etb                 timestamptz,
  etc                 timestamptz,
  survey_type         text not null,
  client_reference    text,
  parties             jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  assigned_surveyor_id uuid references public.surveyors(id),
  assigned_user_id    uuid references auth.users(id) on delete set null,
  status              text not null default 'open',
  on_hold_reason      text,
  survey_id           uuid references public.surveys(id) on delete set null,
  gbqs_order_id       uuid references public.orders(id) on delete set null,
  credit_used         boolean not null default false,
  created_by          uuid,
  created_at          timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at          timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint surveyor_jobs_status_check check (status in ('draft','open','in_progress','submitted','on_hold','issued','cancelled','merged')),
  constraint surveyor_jobs_type_check check (survey_type in ('bunker_quantity_survey','on_hire_bunker','on_hire_condition','on_hire_bc',
    'off_hire_bunker','off_hire_condition','off_hire_bc','bunker_delivery_survey'))
);
create index if not exists surveyor_jobs_company_idx on public.surveyor_jobs(company_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists surveyor_jobs_vessel_idx on public.surveyor_jobs(vessel_id);
comment on table public.surveyor_jobs is
  'Surveyor access: own jobs of a survey company (reference SVY-YYYY-NNNN). Never an order: no GBQS client, no GBQS invoice. status merged = joined an existing GBQS order (A13 case 1, no credit used).';

alter table public.surveys add column if not exists surveyor_job_id uuid references public.surveyor_jobs(id) on delete set null;
alter table public.surveys add column if not exists self_reported boolean not null default false;
create index if not exists surveys_surveyor_job_idx on public.surveys(surveyor_job_id) where surveyor_job_id is not null;

-- 5. Tegoed ------------------------------------------------------------------
create table if not exists public.sa_credit_bundles (
  code             text primary key,
  label            text not null,
  credits          integer not null check (credits > 0),
  unit_price_usd   numeric(10,2) not null,
  total_usd        numeric(10,2) generated always as (credits * unit_price_usd) stored,
  invoice_allowed  boolean not null default false,
  active           boolean not null default true,
  sort             integer not null default 0
);

 ('b10','Bundle of 10',10,27.50,false,2),
 ('b25','Bundle of 25',25,25.00,true,3),

  unit_price_usd = excluded.unit_price_usd, invoice_allowed = excluded.invoice_allowed, sort = excluded.sort;

create table if not exists public.sa_price_agreements (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id     uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  discount_pct   numeric(5,2) not null,
  valid_until    date,
  source         text,
  proposal_id    uuid,
  created_by     text,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  revoked_at     timestamptz,
  constraint sa_price_agreements_pct_range check (discount_pct > 0 and discount_pct <= 15)
);
create index if not exists sa_price_agreements_company_idx on public.sa_price_agreements(company_id);

create table if not exists public.sa_credit_lots (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id      uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  source          text not null,
  credits         integer not null,
  remaining       integer not null,
  unit_price_usd  numeric(10,2) not null default 0,
  bundle_code     text references public.sa_credit_bundles(code),
  purchase_ref    text,
  expires_at      timestamptz not null,
  note            text,
  created_by      text,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint sa_credit_lots_source_ok check (source in ('free','early_bird','purchase','adjust','restore')),
  constraint sa_credit_lots_credits_pos check (credits > 0),
  constraint sa_credit_lots_remaining_range check (remaining >= 0 and remaining <= credits)
);
create index if not exists sa_credit_lots_company_idx on public.sa_credit_lots(company_id, expires_at);

create table if not exists public.sa_credit_moves (
  id          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  company_id  uuid not null references public.surveyor_companies(id) on delete cascade,
  lot_id      uuid references public.sa_credit_lots(id) on delete set null,
  kind        text not null,
  delta       integer not null,
  job_id      uuid references public.surveyor_jobs(id) on delete set null,
  note        text,
  created_by  text,
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint sa_credit_moves_kind_ok check (kind in ('grant','use','expire','adjust','restore'))
);
create index if not exists sa_credit_moves_company_idx on public.sa_credit_moves(company_id, created_at desc);

-- 6. Rechten -----------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array['sa_regions','sa_region_countries','sa_haven_region_overrides','surveyor_companies','surveyor_company_users',
    'surveyor_company_ports','surveyor_clients','sa_counters','surveyor_jobs','sa_credit_bundles','sa_price_agreements','sa_credit_lots','sa_credit_moves']
  loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', t);
    execute format('revoke all on public.%I from anon, authenticated', t);
    execute format('grant select, insert, update, delete on public.%I to service_role', t);
  end loop;
end $$;

-- 7. Functies ----------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.sa_setting_int(p_key text, p_default integer)
returns integer language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce((select nullif(trim(value),'')::integer from system_settings where key = p_key), p_default)
$$;

create or replace function public.sa_my_company_id()
returns uuid language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select u.company_id from surveyor_company_users u join surveyor_companies c on c.id = u.company_id
   where u.user_id = auth.uid() and u.status = 'active' and c.status in ('pending','approved')
$$;

create or replace function public.sa_is_early_bird(p_email text, p_domain text)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select exists (select 1 from surveyor_interest si
                  where si.early_bird and (si.email = lower(trim(p_email)) or (p_domain is not null and si.domain = lower(p_domain))))
      or coalesce((select nullif(trim(value),'')::timestamptz from system_settings where key = 'sa_live_at') > now(), true)
$$;

create or replace function public.sa_next_job_reference()
returns text language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare y integer := extract(year from now() at time zone 'UTC')::integer; n integer;
begin
  insert into sa_counters(name, year, last) values ('surveyor_job', y, 1)
  on conflict (name, year) do update set last = sa_counters.last + 1
  returning last into n;
  return 'SVY-' || y || '-' || lpad(n::text, 4, '0');
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_credit_balance(p_company_id uuid)
returns integer language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select coalesce(sum(remaining), 0)::integer from sa_credit_lots
   where company_id = p_company_id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now()
$$;

create or replace function public.sa_credit_grant(
  p_company_id uuid, p_source text, p_credits integer, p_unit_price numeric default 0,
  p_note text default null, p_by text default null, p_bundle_code text default null, p_purchase_ref text default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare v_lot uuid; v_exp timestamptz;
begin
  if p_credits is null or p_credits <= 0 then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'message', 'Aantal moet groter dan 0 zijn.');
  end if;
  v_exp := now() + make_interval(months => sa_setting_int('sa_credit_validity_months', 12));
  insert into sa_credit_lots(company_id, source, credits, remaining, unit_price_usd, bundle_code, purchase_ref, expires_at, note, created_by)
  values (p_company_id, p_source, p_credits, p_credits, coalesce(p_unit_price, 0), p_bundle_code, p_purchase_ref, v_exp, p_note, p_by)
  returning id into v_lot;
  insert into sa_credit_moves(company_id, lot_id, kind, delta, note, created_by)
  values (p_company_id, v_lot, case when p_source = 'adjust' then 'adjust' else 'grant' end, p_credits, p_note, p_by);
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'lot_id', v_lot, 'expires_at', v_exp, 'balance', sa_credit_balance(p_company_id));
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_grant_welcome_credits(p_company_id uuid, p_by text default 'system')
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare c surveyor_companies; v_free integer := sa_setting_int('sa_free_credits', 2);
        v_extra integer := sa_setting_int('sa_early_bird_extra', 1); v_given integer := 0;
begin
  select * into c from surveyor_companies where id = p_company_id;
  if c.id is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'message', 'Bedrijf niet gevonden.'); end if;
  if exists (select 1 from sa_credit_lots l join surveyor_companies o on o.id = l.company_id
              where l.source in ('free','early_bird')
                and (o.id = c.id or (c.domain is not null and o.domain = c.domain))) then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'given', 0, 'message', 'Gratis tegoed al eerder toegekend (bedrijf of domein).',
                              'balance', sa_credit_balance(c.id));
  end if;
  if v_free > 0 then
    perform sa_credit_grant(c.id, 'free', v_free, 0, 'Welcome credits', p_by); v_given := v_given + v_free;
  end if;
  if c.early_bird and v_extra > 0 then
    perform sa_credit_grant(c.id, 'early_bird', v_extra, 0, 'Early registrant bonus', p_by); v_given := v_given + v_extra;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'given', v_given, 'balance', sa_credit_balance(c.id));
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_credit_use(p_job_id uuid, p_by text default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare j surveyor_jobs; v_lot sa_credit_lots;
begin
  select * into j from surveyor_jobs where id = p_job_id for update;
  if j.id is null then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'message', 'Job niet gevonden.'); end if;
  if j.credit_used then return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'already', true, 'balance', sa_credit_balance(j.company_id)); end if;
  if j.status = 'merged' then return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'free', true, 'message', 'Job via GlobalBQS: geen tegoed.'); end if;
  select * into v_lot from sa_credit_lots
   where company_id = j.company_id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now()
   order by expires_at, created_at limit 1 for update;
  if v_lot.id is null then
    update surveyor_jobs set status = 'on_hold', on_hold_reason = 'no_credits', updated_at = now() where id = j.id;
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'on_hold', true, 'message', 'No credits left: the report is on hold until credits are added.');
  end if;
  update sa_credit_lots set remaining = remaining - 1 where id = v_lot.id;
  insert into sa_credit_moves(company_id, lot_id, kind, delta, job_id, created_by) values (j.company_id, v_lot.id, 'use', -1, j.id, p_by);
  update surveyor_jobs set credit_used = true,
         status = case when status = 'on_hold' then 'submitted' else status end,
         on_hold_reason = null, updated_at = now()
   where id = j.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'lot_id', v_lot.id, 'balance', sa_credit_balance(j.company_id));
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_credit_restore(p_job_id uuid, p_note text default null, p_by text default null)
returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare j surveyor_jobs; m sa_credit_moves; v_lot sa_credit_lots;
begin
  select * into j from surveyor_jobs where id = p_job_id for update;
  if j.id is null or not j.credit_used then return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'message', 'Geen afgeboekt tegoed voor deze job.'); end if;
  select * into m from sa_credit_moves where job_id = j.id and kind = 'use' order by created_at desc limit 1;
  select * into v_lot from sa_credit_lots where id = m.lot_id for update;
  if v_lot.id is not null and v_lot.expires_at > now() and v_lot.remaining < v_lot.credits then
    update sa_credit_lots set remaining = remaining + 1 where id = v_lot.id;
    insert into sa_credit_moves(company_id, lot_id, kind, delta, job_id, note, created_by)
    values (j.company_id, v_lot.id, 'restore', 1, j.id, p_note, p_by);
  else
    perform sa_credit_grant(j.company_id, 'restore', 1, 0, coalesce(p_note, 'Credit restored'), p_by);
  end if;
  update surveyor_jobs set credit_used = false, updated_at = now() where id = j.id;
  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'balance', sa_credit_balance(j.company_id));
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_credit_expire()
returns integer language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r record; n integer := 0;
begin
  for r in select * from sa_credit_lots where remaining > 0 and expires_at <= now() for update loop
    insert into sa_credit_moves(company_id, lot_id, kind, delta, note, created_by)
    values (r.company_id, r.id, 'expire', -r.remaining, 'Expired after validity period', 'system');
    update sa_credit_lots set remaining = 0 where id = r.id;
    n := n + 1;
  end loop;
  return n;
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_bundle_price(p_company_id uuid, p_bundle_code text)
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'bundle', b.code, 'credits', b.credits, 'list_unit_usd', b.unit_price_usd, 'list_total_usd', b.total_usd,
    'discount_pct', coalesce(a.discount_pct, 0),
    'unit_usd', round(b.unit_price_usd * (1 - coalesce(a.discount_pct, 0) / 100), 2),
    'total_usd', round(b.unit_price_usd * (1 - coalesce(a.discount_pct, 0) / 100), 2) * b.credits,
    'invoice_allowed', b.invoice_allowed)
  from sa_credit_bundles b
  left join lateral (select discount_pct from sa_price_agreements
                      where company_id = p_company_id and revoked_at is null and (valid_until is null or valid_until >= current_date)
                      order by discount_pct desc limit 1) a on true
  where b.code = p_bundle_code and b.active
$$;

create or replace function public.sa_portal_dashboard()
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare
  v_u surveyor_company_users%rowtype;
  v_c surveyor_companies%rowtype;
  v_res jsonb;
begin
  select * into v_u from surveyor_company_users where user_id = auth.uid();
  if not found then return null; end if;
  select * into v_c from surveyor_companies where id = v_u.company_id;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'me', jsonb_build_object('full_name', v_u.full_name, 'email', v_u.email, 'is_office', v_u.is_office,
           'is_surveyor', v_u.is_surveyor, 'is_admin', v_u.is_admin, 'status', v_u.status,
           'role_label', case when v_u.is_office and v_u.is_surveyor then 'Office · Surveyor'
                              when v_u.is_office then 'Office' else 'Surveyor' end),
    'company', jsonb_build_object('id', v_c.id, 'name', v_c.name, 'country', v_c.country, 'status', v_c.status,
           'early_bird', v_c.early_bird, 'logo_path', v_c.logo_path, 'region_code', v_c.region_code,
           'region_name', (select name from sa_regions where code = v_c.region_code),
           'created_at', v_c.created_at, 'verified_at', v_c.verified_at,
           'awaiting_check', v_c.status = 'pending'),
    'credits', jsonb_build_object(
           'balance', (select coalesce(sum(remaining),0)::int from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_c.id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now()),
           'free', (select coalesce(sum(remaining),0)::int from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_c.id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now() and source in ('welcome','early_bird')),
           'next_expiry', (select min(expires_at) from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_c.id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now()),
           'low_warn', coalesce((select value::int from system_settings where key = 'sa_low_credit_warn'), 2)),
    'counts', jsonb_build_object(
           'upcoming', (select count(*) from surveyor_jobs j where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status in ('draft','open','in_progress')
                          and (v_u.is_office or j.assigned_user_id = v_u.user_id)),
           'on_hold', (select count(*) from surveyor_jobs j where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status = 'on_hold'
                          and (v_u.is_office or j.assigned_user_id = v_u.user_id)),
           'issued', (select count(*) from surveyor_jobs j where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status = 'issued'),
           'issued_12m', (select count(*) from surveyor_jobs j where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status = 'issued' and j.updated_at > now() - interval '12 months'),
           'vessels_12m', (select count(distinct coalesce(j.imo_number, j.vessel_name)) from surveyor_jobs j where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status = 'issued' and j.updated_at > now() - interval '12 months')),
    'upcoming', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'eta' nulls last) from (
           select jsonb_build_object('id', j.id, 'reference', j.reference, 'vessel', j.vessel_name, 'imo', j.imo_number,
                  'port', coalesce(h.naam, j.port_text), 'eta', j.eta, 'etc', j.etc, 'survey_type', j.survey_type,
                  'client', sc.name, 'status', j.status, 'source', 'own') as x
           from surveyor_jobs j
           left join havens h on h.id = j.haven_id
           left join surveyor_clients sc on sc.id = j.surveyor_client_id
           where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status in ('draft','open','in_progress','on_hold')
             and (v_u.is_office or j.assigned_user_id = v_u.user_id)
           order by j.eta nulls last limit 10) s), '[]'::jsonb),
    'recent', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x) from (
           select jsonb_build_object('id', j.id, 'reference', j.reference, 'vessel', j.vessel_name,
                  'port', coalesce(h.naam, j.port_text), 'survey_type', j.survey_type, 'client', sc.name, 'updated_at', j.updated_at) as x
           from surveyor_jobs j
           left join havens h on h.id = j.haven_id
           left join surveyor_clients sc on sc.id = j.surveyor_client_id
           where j.company_id = v_c.id and j.status = 'issued'
             and (v_u.is_office or j.assigned_user_id = v_u.user_id)
           order by j.updated_at desc limit 5) s), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_res;
  return v_res;
end $$;

create or replace function public.sa_portal_credits()
returns jsonb language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path to 'public' as $$
declare
  v_u surveyor_company_users%rowtype;
  v_disc numeric;
  v_until date;
begin
  select * into v_u from surveyor_company_users where user_id = auth.uid();
  if not found then return null; end if;

  select discount_pct, valid_until into v_disc, v_until
  from sa_price_agreements
  where company_id = v_u.company_id and revoked_at is null and (valid_until is null or valid_until >= current_date)
  order by created_at desc limit 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'can_buy', v_u.is_office,
    'company_status', (select status from surveyor_companies where id = v_u.company_id),
    'balance', (select coalesce(sum(remaining),0)::int from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_u.company_id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now()),
    'next_expiry', (select min(expires_at) from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_u.company_id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now()),
    'next_expiry_credits', (select coalesce(sum(remaining),0)::int from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_u.company_id and remaining > 0
                             and expires_at = (select min(expires_at) from sa_credit_lots where company_id = v_u.company_id and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now())),
    'used_12m', (select coalesce(-sum(delta),0)::int from sa_credit_moves where company_id = v_u.company_id and kind = 'use' and created_at > now() - interval '12 months'),
    'agreement', case when v_disc is null then null else jsonb_build_object('discount_pct', v_disc, 'valid_until', v_until) end,
    'lots', case when v_u.is_office then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'source', l.source, 'credits', l.credits, 'remaining', l.remaining, 'bundle', b.label,
              'expires_at', l.expires_at, 'created_at', l.created_at, 'expired', l.expires_at <= now()) order by l.created_at desc)
              from sa_credit_lots l left join sa_credit_bundles b on b.code = l.bundle_code
              where l.company_id = v_u.company_id), '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end,
    'moves', case when v_u.is_office then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by (x->>'created_at') desc) from (
              select jsonb_build_object('kind', m.kind, 'delta', m.delta, 'created_at', m.created_at, 'note', m.note, 'job_reference', j.reference) x
              from sa_credit_moves m left join surveyor_jobs j on j.id = m.job_id
              where m.company_id = v_u.company_id order by m.created_at desc limit 50) s), '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end,
    'bundles', case when v_u.is_office then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'code', b.code, 'label', b.label, 'credits', b.credits, 'unit_price_usd', b.unit_price_usd, 'total_usd', b.total_usd,
              'unit_net_usd', round(b.unit_price_usd * (1 - coalesce(v_disc,0)/100), 2),
              'total_net_usd', round(b.total_usd * (1 - coalesce(v_disc,0)/100), 2),
              'invoice_allowed', b.invoice_allowed) order by b.sort)
              from sa_credit_bundles b where b.active), '[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end
  );
end $$;
revoke all on function public.sa_portal_credits() from public, anon;
grant execute on function public.sa_portal_credits() to authenticated;

create or replace function public.portal_changelog()
 returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public'
as $function$
  with r as (select * from app_changelog where show_in_portal and published
               and portal_audience in ('all', case when portal_is_surveyor_only() then 'surveyor' else 'client' end)),
  d as (select released_on, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ref', ref, 'title', title_en, 'body', body_en) order by sort, created_at) as items,
               count(*) as n
          from r group by released_on)
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', released_on, 'ref', ref, 'title', title_en, 'body', body_en)
                                         order by released_on desc, sort, created_at desc) from r), '[]'::jsonb),
    'days', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date', released_on, 'count', n, 'items', items) order by released_on desc) from d), '[]'::jsonb),
    'unseen', exists (select 1 from r a
                        where coalesce(a.published_at, a.created_at) > coalesce((select seen_at from portal_changelog_seen s where s.user_id = auth.uid()), '-infinity'::timestamptz)
                          and a.released_on >= (select coalesce((select created_at::date from auth.users where id = auth.uid()), current_date) - 60)))
$function$;

 returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public'
as $function$

  select case when not (select client or surveyor from who) then '[]'::jsonb else
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'doc_no', d.doc_no, 'title', d.title, 'category', d.category,
        'category_label', case d.category when 'manual' then 'Manual' when 'security' then 'Security'
                                          when 'legal' then 'Legal' when 'commercial' then 'Commercial' else 'Document' end,
        'description', d.portal_description, 'version', c.version, 'effective_date', c.effective_date,
        'file_name', c.file_name, 'size_kb', round(coalesce(c.size_bytes, 0) / 1024.0)
      ) order by d.sort, d.doc_no)
      from controlled_documents d
      join controlled_document_versions c on c.document_id = d.id and c.status = 'current'
     where d.active and d.audience = 'customer'
       and case when (select client from who) then d.portal_visible else d.surveyor_visible end), '[]'::jsonb)
  end

-- Finance overview also lists surveyor credit invoices (no client): company = surveyor company + ' (surveyor)'.
-- Same output shape; client invoices unchanged. New field invoice_kind ('client' | 'surveyor').
create or replace function public.ops_finance_overview()
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public' as $function$
select jsonb_build_object(
 'uninvoicedOrders', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.company asc, x.created_at desc), '[]') from (
   select o.id, o.gbqs_reference, o.vessel_name, o.port, o.survey_types,
          coalesce(stc.description, o.survey_types) as survey_type_label,
          o.etc, o.created_at, o.client_id,
          c.company, c.address, c.zip_code, c.city, c.country, c.email_admin,
          c.vat_number, c.price_logbook, c.price_voyager,
          coalesce(s.status, 'pending') as status,
          o.ready_to_invoice,
          (select json_agg(json_build_object('description', ec.description, 'amount', ec.amount))
             from order_extra_costs ec where ec.order_id = o.id) as extra_costs
   from orders o
   join clients c on c.id = o.client_id
   left join surveys s on s.order_id = o.id
   left join survey_types_config stc on stc.name = o.survey_types
   where o.id not in (select order_id from invoice_lines where order_id is not null)
     and s.status = 'issued') x),
 'invoices', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.created_at desc), '[]') from (
   select i.id, i.invoice_number, i.client_id,
          coalesce(c.company, sc.name || ' (surveyor)') as company, i.total_amount,
          i.paid_at, i.notes, i.created_at, i.sent_at, i.sent_to, i.pdf_file_id,
          coalesce(c.payment_term_days, 0) as payment_term_days, i.po_reference,
          (i.created_at + make_interval(days => coalesce(c.payment_term_days, 0))) as due_date,
          (i.paid_at is null and now() > i.created_at + make_interval(days => coalesce(c.payment_term_days, 0))) as overdue,
          count(il.id)::text as order_count,
          string_agg(o.gbqs_reference, ', ' order by o.gbqs_reference) as order_refs,
          array_agg(il.order_id) filter (where il.order_id is not null) as order_ids_arr,
          case when i.surveyor_company_id is not null then 'surveyor' else 'client' end as invoice_kind
   from invoices i
   left join clients c on c.id = i.client_id
   left join surveyor_companies sc on sc.id = i.surveyor_company_id
   left join invoice_lines il on il.invoice_id = i.id
   left join orders o on o.id = il.order_id
   where i.client_id is not null or i.surveyor_company_id is not null
   group by i.id, c.company, c.payment_term_days, sc.name) x)
);
$function$;

create or replace function public.ops_finance_overview()
returns jsonb language sql stable security definer set search_path to 'public' as $function$
select jsonb_build_object(
 'uninvoicedOrders', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.company asc, x.created_at desc), '[]') from (
   select o.id, o.gbqs_reference, o.vessel_name, o.port, o.survey_types,
          coalesce(stc.description, o.survey_types) as survey_type_label,
          o.etc, o.created_at, o.client_id,
          c.company, c.address, c.zip_code, c.city, c.country, c.email_admin,
          c.vat_number, c.price_logbook, c.price_voyager,
          coalesce(s.status, 'pending') as status,
          o.ready_to_invoice,
          (select json_agg(json_build_object('description', ec.description, 'amount', ec.amount))
             from order_extra_costs ec where ec.order_id = o.id) as extra_costs
   from orders o
   join clients c on c.id = o.client_id
   left join surveys s on s.order_id = o.id
   left join survey_types_config stc on stc.name = o.survey_types
   where o.id not in (select order_id from invoice_lines where order_id is not null)
     and s.status = 'issued') x),
 'invoices', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.created_at desc), '[]') from (
   select i.id, i.invoice_number, i.client_id,
          coalesce(c.company, sc.name || ' (surveyor)') as company, i.total_amount,
          i.paid_at, i.notes, i.created_at, i.sent_at, i.sent_to, i.pdf_file_id,
          coalesce(c.payment_term_days, 0) as payment_term_days, i.po_reference,
          (i.created_at + make_interval(days => coalesce(c.payment_term_days, 0))) as due_date,
          (i.paid_at is null and now() > i.created_at + make_interval(days => coalesce(c.payment_term_days, 0))) as overdue,
          count(il.id)::text as order_count,
          string_agg(o.gbqs_reference, ', ' order by o.gbqs_reference) as order_refs,
          array_agg(il.order_id) filter (where il.order_id is not null) as order_ids_arr,
          case when i.surveyor_company_id is not null then 'surveyor' else 'client' end as invoice_kind,
          i.payment_method
   from invoices i
   left join clients c on c.id = i.client_id
   left join surveyor_companies sc on sc.id = i.surveyor_company_id
   left join invoice_lines il on il.invoice_id = i.id
   left join orders o on o.id = il.order_id
   where i.client_id is not null or i.surveyor_company_id is not null
   group by i.id, c.company, c.payment_term_days, sc.name) x)
);
$function$;
